comments.author: Mace
comments.body_html: Love it! Such a great idea, makes me thinking about own recipes. Tried the first one, it works!! Do I get it right, this can only create vanilla items, so meds or ammo from other mods are not craftable? No critics, just for my understanding. Great mod!

comments.author: viniHNS
comments.body_html: Actually, it supports any modded item. Select the ‘CUSTOM’ option in the ingredients/output dropdown and manually enter the Item ID (e.g. 69b6a5c44d96478be14381a9 ).
